boundaries.boundary: after idempotency lookup before claim
boundaries.expected: no durable effect

boundaries.boundary: after idempotency claim statement before business statement
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes claim and no durable effect

boundaries.boundary: after business statement before audit statement
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes business effect

boundaries.boundary: after audit statement before outbox statement
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes business and audit

boundaries.boundary: after conditional notification before outbox statement
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes business audit and notification

boundaries.boundary: after outbox statement before commit
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes every effect

boundaries.boundary: after commit before response
boundaries.expected: retry returns recorded result and creates no second business effect

boundaries.boundary: after Inbox statement before business statement
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes Inbox record

boundaries.boundary: after business statement before audit and outbox
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes business effect

boundaries.boundary: after Inbox applied statement before commit
boundaries.expected: transaction rollback removes Inbox and every effect

boundaries.boundary: after PostgreSQL commit before NATS ack
boundaries.expected: redelivery hits Inbox and creates no second business effect

boundaries.boundary: after Outbox claim transaction commit before publish
boundaries.expected: claim becomes retryable and event remains unpublished

boundaries.boundary: after publish before broker ack
boundaries.expected: retry may duplicate delivery with identical event ID and digest

boundaries.boundary: after broker ack before published statement
boundaries.expected: retry may duplicate delivery with identical event ID and digest

boundaries.boundary: after published statement before commit
boundaries.expected: rollback leaves event retryable

boundaries.boundary: after published commit
boundaries.expected: event remains retained and is not republished by normal scan

boundaries.boundary: after challenge consume statement before key registration
boundaries.expected: rollback leaves real challenge unconsumed and no device exists

boundaries.boundary: after device statement before session and family statements
boundaries.expected: rollback removes device and preserves prior devices

boundaries.boundary: after session and family statements before audit notification and outbox
boundaries.expected: rollback removes new device session family and preserves prior devices

boundaries.boundary: after prior revocations before new device statement
boundaries.expected: rollback restores prior devices sessions and families

boundaries.boundary: after new session statement before commit
boundaries.expected: rollback restores prior state and removes replacement state

boundaries.boundary: after family lock before state evaluation
boundaries.expected: rollback leaves token state unchanged

boundaries.boundary: after descendant token-digest statement before commit
boundaries.expected: rollback keeps ancestor active and removes descendant

boundaries.boundary: after family revoke statement before audit notification and outbox
boundaries.expected: rollback leaves family unchanged so complete retry repeats atomic detection

boundaries.boundary: after counter statement before lock audit and notification
boundaries.expected: rollback removes increment and every lock side effect

boundaries.boundary: after incident upsert before audit notification and outbox
boundaries.expected: rollback removes incident and every side effect

boundaries.boundary: after incident commit before observer result
boundaries.expected: retry reuses the open incident and emits no duplicate audit or notification
